integrity: Mathematical derivation from publicly available source equations; source authorship belongs to F. A. Shiha. No independent scientific validation has been undertaken. The earlier qualitative quantile reversal observed in the source is acknowledged, not represented as new.
scientific_limitations: The theorem compares η at fixed positive ω, not joint variation in ω and η, and addresses exact stochastic order for powered unit-valued observations, not inference or multivariate dependence. An equivalent unindexed theorem cannot be ruled out by search alone. Finite numerical examples are not substitutes for the all-parameter analytic proof.
title: Sharp power stop-loss transition for the unit Shiha distribution
